title: Anthropic's Wealth-Creation Example: Seven Founders Each Sell 250 Million, Each Still Worth 18 Billion
excerpt: In the AI wealth-creation wave, Anthropic’s seven leaders have delivered a textbook-grade fortune-making performance. According to the prospectus updated by Tec
content_html:
In the AI wealth-creation wave, Anthropic’s seven leaders have delivered a textbook-grade fortune-making performance. According to the prospectus updated by TechCrunch on November 10, at the time of the company’s IPO, these seven co-founders each plan to sell 3.3784 million shares.

Selling only 1.4%, each still sits on $18 billion

Based on an offering range of $70 to $78 and using the midpoint of $74, each would pocket about $250 million, for a combined total of about $1.75 billion among the seven. That looks astonishing, but it is actually a very small cut: the sale accounts for only about 1.4% of each person’s original holdings. After the transaction, each will still hold 237 million to 240 million Class A shares, which at $74 translates to paper wealth approaching $18 billion. In other words, what they sell is pocket change; what they keep is an empire.

$1.4 trillion valuation, ANT about to list

The offering itself also sets a new benchmark. Anthropic plans to issue 825 million Class A shares, of which the company itself will issue about 801 million, with the remainder sold by the seven founders. If the offering price hits the top of the range at $78, the company’s fully diluted valuation could reach $1.404 trillion, and it will list on Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT". Although the seven have cashed out part of their shares, they retain 50.1% of voting power through Founder LLC and one non-economic Class F special share; the Long-Term Benefit Trust continues to hold a majority of board seats, and the balance of power has not tilted at all.
